WITH rating_avgs AS (
  SELECT rating, AVG(replacement_cost / rental_rate) AS avg_ratio
  FROM film
  WHERE replacement_cost IS NOT NULL AND rental_rate IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY rating
),
overall_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS avg_ratio
  FROM rating_avgs
),
kept AS (
  SELECT r.avg_ratio, r.avg_ratio - o.avg_ratio AS difference
  FROM rating_avgs r
  CROSS JOIN overall_avg o
  WHERE r.avg_ratio IS NOT NULL
    AND o.avg_ratio IS NOT NULL
    AND r.avg_ratio > o.avg_ratio
)
SELECT AVG(avg_ratio), AVG(difference)
FROM kept
